title: PvP Club
description: A practice server for modern PvP.
body:
## PvP Club
A modern practice server where you can duel other players and have fun in party modes!

- Duel queue to fight random players in various modes
- Party modes (team duels, FFAs, host battles, etc.)
- Different regions available for lower latency, swappable in-game
  - NA (Ashburn, VA)
  - EU (Frankfurt, DE)
  - AS (Singapore)
  - AU (Sydney)

Version **1.21.11** is recommended for the optimal experience.
